name: Delaware

flag.description: A colonial-blue field with a buff (tan) diamond holding the state coat of arms, and the date DECEMBER 7, 1787 written beneath the diamond.
flag.symbolism: Blue and buff were the colours of George Washington's Continental Army uniform; the date is the day Delaware ratified the US Constitution.

hook: Delaware sets its arms in a tan diamond on blue and signs it with a date, December 7, 1787, the day it became the first state.
trivia: Delaware was the first state to ratify the US Constitution, which is why it calls itself "The First State".
The coat of arms dates from 1777 and shows a farmer and a militiaman beside a shield with a wheat sheaf, an ear of corn and an ox.
